portal_prod_promotion.summary: Canonical mechanism for promoting portal commits from the DEV branch to the PROD branch (opalinvest.dev). Adopt the ephemeral-worktree form for EVERY portal PROD promotion. Never `git checkout PROD` in the portal main working tree.
portal_prod_promotion.defect_history: The pre-2026-05-22 cherry-pick mechanism (SSCN_DIVDEF.006 Phase 1, used for the .001-.011 set and the SSCN_UNVREV set) ran `git checkout PROD` directly in the SHARED portal main working tree, cherry-picked, pushed, tagged -- with NO terminating `git checkout DEV`. The main tree was left abandoned on PROD. The state was sticky: subsequent promotions stacked onto PROD because the tree was already there, and any agent running a dev server off the main tree saw PROD code instead of DEV. Found stranded twice (portal reflog 4f8502e6 2026-05-20 14:39 DEV->PROD with no return; again 2026-05-22). Flagged by 0.3.0_DE_TradingOperations 2026-05-22, Andrew-escalated.

procedure.step: 1. `cd portal && git fetch origin` -- main tree stays on DEV.
2. `git worktree add .runtmp/portal-prod-promote PROD` -- ephemeral worktree checked out on PROD; the main tree never moves.
3. `cd .runtmp/portal-prod-promote && git pull origin PROD` -- PROD baseline.
4. Cherry-pick the approved commit set in DEV commit order. On a conflict: do NOT resolve unilaterally -- RAVC2 PARTIAL to COO/CTO.
5. `bun install && bun run typecheck && bun run build` -- all exit 0.
6. `git push origin PROD` -- GHA deploy.yml auto-fires (bun build -> S3 sync s3://opalinvest-portal -> CloudFront EVTSA9VEHNZVH invalidation).
7. Tag if the TO requires it (`portal-vX.Y.Z`).
9. Verify: `git -C portal branch --show-current` MUST report DEV. Bump the parent CLOUD `portal` gitlink to the new PROD HEAD if the TO calls for it.

portal_prod_promotion.invariant: The portal main working tree is permanently on DEV. Branch state cannot leak to a dev server or a later promotion because the main tree never moves. Same isolation 0.3.0_DE uses for the :5175 DEV preview worktree.
